notes: Read-only candidate registration study; production repository not modified.
Instances scale is WORLD scale = source scale × 1.25.
All five PNGs viewed separately; actual pixel alpha revalidated separately even where geometry corresponds closely.
All 7 selected current house instances meet original 5-source-pixel exposed-foot tolerance. NE uses asymmetric annex-v3; the previous symmetric thatch-left-source-v2 is rejected and not included.
Selection cell is an interaction owner, never a body placement pivot. Front/door points are distinct physical features.
Contours are conservative visible wall/door targeting; not roof alpha or a substitute ground footprint.
House original hidden-rear audit is conservative/inferred. Exposed-foot pass does not certify hidden-rear foundation coverage.

instances.fitMethod: Exact minimax max absolute coordinate error across 3 exposed physical L/F/R base landmarks, uniform positive scale + translation only. Minimized maximum of pairwise affine residual bounds; no roof/canvas fitting.

originalGroundAudit.rearUncertainty: Visible lower wall edges define the front and sides; the concealed rear corner is inferred with an eight-source-pixel conservative allowance. The roof does not define physical collision.

instances.staticBoundary: Pixel/geometry prediction only, not Board.Pick runtime or natural play. Entry/approach samples fixed before tests; no sample selected by picking. Final binding must independently check complete original wall responsibility and true visible actor/empty doorway behavior.
